response: ERC-1967 defines standard storage slots for proxy contracts so that tooling can locate the implementation without collisions. UUPS proxies place the upgrade logic in the implementation rather than the proxy, which saves gas but risks bricking the contract if an implementation omits the upgrade function. Access to upgrades is typically restricted to an owner or admin role.
